title: Parallax Harbor City
description: A detailed isometric fantasy map of a bustling medieval harbor city named Parallax. The city is divided by a turquoise river with multiple bridges, featuring dense clusters of colorful buildings, docks with ships, a large amphitheater, and a smoky industrial area in the upper right.
prompt: Isometric bird's eye view of a detailed fantasy harbor city named Parallax, divided by a winding turquoise river with stone bridges, dense clusters of colorful medieval buildings, busy docks with wooden piers and ships, a large amphitheater, smoky industrial district with chimneys, scattered market squares and people, painted in a rich storybook illustration style with warm and cool tones
